scope: Approved bounded fresh primary-source review of exactly Svetlinki and ART Izba. This is source evidence, not an override or replacement for catalogue/pricing checks.

methodology.order: Actual first-party Book entry/menu first, followed by selected service, public prices and full relevant terms.
methodology.access: Read-only ordinary public HTTPS GET. The browser inventory was unavailable; public HTML and visible text were inspected without executing forms.
boundaries: No account access, reservations, phone calls, form/date/quantity selections, consent submissions, cart actions, checkout, payments or notifications.
No Google/paid services or customer/private data.
No copied source photos, artwork, reviews, course materials or promotional prose. Only concise factual summaries and published service/price facts.
HTTPS response-body hashes are evidence, not permanence or a guarantee of availability.

qualifications: Literal published standard 28 EUR per participant; 15% discount applies to online payment and is not calculated or substituted here.
All painting materials, wine and water, or juice for minors, are included.
At least 6 participants; if the provider cancels for insufficient attendance it offers refund or another event within 3 months.
Event cancellation earlier than 48 hours is governed by the published terms. Within 48 hours the place may be transferred subject to the notification rules; no blanket refund promise is made.
The product shows 2–3 hours and narrative says three hours; no invented fixed duration scalar is exported.
The separate 20 EUR iris-photography gift, two-for-one event totals, retail photos, vouchers and old generic FAQ 48 BGN tariff are not imported as this painting price.
Footer payment-currency boilerplate mentions BGN conversion; the literal visible product EUR figure is retained without performing our own conversion or asserting a charged currency.
Current venue is Cherni Vrah 33E, not registered Dobrila 10, historic Vitosha 192 or the Blagoevgrad branch.

validity.basis: The actual dated event. It is not a permanent standing service price and must expire after this date.
